reply_draft: Thanks for reaching out about your deposit. Here is some general guidance that may help. Based on our help article "Card deposit processing times": Card deposits are usually instant, but may be delayed by issuer checks, network issues, or pending review. If this doesn't resolve it, a support agent can review your case.

Thanks for contacting us about resetting your password. Here are some general steps to try. Based on our help article "Password reset troubleshooting": If the client does not receive a reset email, confirm the registered email address, check spam folders, wait a few minutes, and retry. If this doesn't resolve it, a support agent can review your case.

A support agent can review your account status if you need more help.
